# OpenToolHub

> OpenToolHub is a static, builder-first catalog of public APIs, open data, starter stacks, templates, and worked examples. Start with a plain-language project idea and follow it to a use case, a stack, an API, and a starting point. There is no backend and the published site makes no model call.

Canonical site: https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/

## Start here

- [Builder](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/index.html): describe an idea, choose areas and experience level, and get a path.
- [Use cases](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/use-cases.html): browse and search all eleven discovery paths.
- [A complete use case](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/use-case.html?id=travel-planner): one path with its stack, APIs, template, and worked example.
- [Stacks](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/stacks.html): compare tool combinations and alternatives per slot.
- [Templates](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/templates.html): starter and variant projects that exist in this repository.
- [APIs](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/apis.html): auth, pricing model, integration complexity, and data freshness.
- [Local AI](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/ai.html): optional, local-only panel. The published page explains how to run `scripts/ai_proxy.py` with your own provider; it makes no model call and holds no key.

## Machine-readable catalog

Every page reads the same validated JSON arrays. These URLs are public and can be fetched directly:

- [Catalog manifest](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/catalog.json): one-request entry point with counts, file URLs, relationships, the recommendation contract, and all six entity arrays.
- [JSON Schema](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/schema.json): draft 2020-12 definitions for every file (`#/$defs/UseCaseFile`, `#/$defs/StackFile`, and so on).
- [Use cases](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/use-cases.json): goals, aliases, keywords, categories, stack ids, template ids, and examples.
- [Stacks](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/stacks.json): one tool slot per job, with alternative API ids.
- [APIs](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/apis.json): official links plus structured provider metadata.
- [Templates](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/templates.json): repository paths and status.
- [Categories](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/categories.json): the shared vocabulary used by the catalog.
- [Examples](https://ghana-gpt.github.io/opentoolhub/data/examples.json): worked walkthroughs, one per use case.

`catalog.json` is generated by `scripts/build_site.py` from the validated source files; the six arrays remain the canonical records. Start with the manifest, then use `files.*.url` and `files.*.schema` for the exact source and schema fragment. Each page also publishes schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter card, and canonical metadata in its HTML head.

## How to answer a builder question

1. Fetch `data/catalog.json` (or `data/use-cases.json` directly) and match the goal against `id`, `name`, `aliases`, and `keywords`.
2. Follow `stack_ids` into `data/stacks.json`; each `tools[].api_ids` entry points into `data/apis.json`.
3. Follow `template_ids` into `data/templates.json` and `example` into `data/examples.json`.
4. Cite the API's official `url` and `docs_url`; do not invent pricing, limits, or availability.

The browser builder and `scripts/recommend.py` share the `deterministic-lexical-v1` contract recorded under `recommendation` in the manifest: the same normalized search document, stopwords, exact-match scores, partial-match threshold, and name tie-break. The browser adds optional area checkboxes as a filter; they do not change the text score.

## Constraints

- Deterministic keyword matching only; there is no hosted search or AI service.
- The optional AI layer is developer-local and off by default: `site/ai.html` only calls `/api/ai/` when a loopback proxy from `scripts/ai_proxy.py` is running, and keys come from the operator's environment.
- The catalog is curated, not exhaustive. Provider terms must be checked at the source.
- The site is static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON, deployable on GitHub Pages under a repository subpath.
- Source repository: https://github.com/ghana-gpt/opentoolhub
